executive_summary: This PRD covers the ALPHA-leg infrastructure for the kill-gate teeth-proof regime (docs/design/kill-gate-teeth-proof-spec.md): a Solomon-writable sealed-prediction registry with genuine DB-level traversal-side blindness, a firing-verification harness that compares discharged sealed predictions against actual gate behavior on the pinned `system_events` observation surface, an aggregate teeth-proof report queryable by Solomon, and a mechanical, fail-closed firing fence that can never arm during venture-1's (ApexNiche) traversal or any attended traversal. It does NOT run a live designed-to-fail venture probe -- that is a separate, later, chairman-gated activity per spec section 6. The kill set (currently stages 3/5/13/24) is derived live from venture_stages.gate_type='kill' at every read site, never hardcoded, per the measured tension with the gate-type-canonicalize invariant module. SC3's citation is corrected in this PRD (see FR-3) from the non-resolving '5c4528b0' identifier to the verified 'W3 packet ruling, coordination corr 5c4528b0' wording, co-citing beca4a47 and d580dac7, per Solomon's pre-LEAD discharge e9087f46 and VALIDATION's independent corroboration.

functional_requirements.title: Sealed-prediction registry with genuine DB-level traversal-side blindness
functional_requirements.description: A `kill_gate_sealed_predictions` table (database/migrations/20260829_kill_gate_sealed_predictions.sql) stores sealed kill-predictions (sealed_hash sha256, sealer_identity in solomon/chairman, sealed_at, nullable pre-attach venture_id/criterion_id/expected_stage/expected_verdict, discharged_at + discharged_content set together at discharge). Traversal-side blindness is a REAL, two-sided Postgres privilege boundary, not an app-level if-check: a dedicated NOLOGIN role `kill_gate_traversal_ro` has ZERO grant on the base table (direct SELECT genuinely errors 42501 permission denied), and the ONLY read surface granted to it is a `kill_gate_teeth_discharged_predictions()` SECURITY DEFINER function that filters to `discharged_at IS NOT NULL` inside the function body. A plain view was tried first and measured (live, this project) to NOT provide this boundary -- Supabase force-persists `security_invoker=on` on every new view regardless of the requested option, which would check the INVOKING role's own (zero) table privileges instead of the owner's; a SECURITY DEFINER function is unaffected by that view-specific hardening and was verified end-to-end (SET ROLE + real query) before being adopted.
acceptance_criteria: Direct SELECT against kill_gate_sealed_predictions under kill_gate_traversal_ro raises a real Postgres error with SQLSTATE 42501
SELECT via kill_gate_teeth_discharged_predictions() under the same role returns only rows with discharged_at IS NOT NULL

The two-sided test (tests/integration/kill-gate-teeth/sealed-predictions-blindness.test.js) exercises a real Postgres session (SET ROLE), never a mock, and is documented to only run against an explicitly designated non-production target per this repo's DB-tier safety convention

functional_requirements.title: Firing-verification harness produces matching teeth-proof records
functional_requirements.description: lib/eva/kill-gate-teeth/firing-verification.js compares a crossing's discharged sealed predictions (read via the FR-1 RPC) against the actual observed verdict. `system_events` is pinned as the PRIMARY authoritative observation surface, because lib/eva/lifecycle/thesis-kill-gate.js's logThesisKillEvent() writes a row on EVERY evaluation (THESIS_KILL_FIRED and THESIS_KILL_CANNOT_EVALUATE alike), unlike chairman_decisions which exists only for FIRED verdicts and is used here strictly as a secondary routing cross-check (was a fired criterion correctly minted to a thesis_kill_tier_b:<criterionId> decision row). Each crossing produces one `kill_gate_teeth_proof_records` row recording gate_type (live-derived), predicted_verdict, observed_verdict, observed_source='system_events', routed_to_decision, matched_prediction (true/false/null-when-uncovered), and the LEO_THESIS_KILL_GATE flag_mode active at evaluation time -- so an observe-mode record can never be misread as proof the gate blocked advancement.
acceptance_criteria: A seeded fixture crossing with a discharged prediction and a matching system_events verdict yields matched_prediction=true
A seeded fixture crossing with a discharged prediction and a disagreeing system_events verdict yields matched_prediction=false
A crossing with no discharged prediction yields matched_prediction=null (uncovered, not silently omitted)
getTeethProofReport() aggregates records only over the live-derived kill stage set and returns a Solomon-queryable summary (total/matched/mismatched/uncovered)

functional_requirements.title: Mechanical, fail-closed firing fence -- corrected SC3 citation (BINDING)
functional_requirements.description: lib/eva/kill-gate-teeth/firing-fence.js's evaluateFiringFence() refuses to arm for venture-1 (ApexNiche, name-matched, unconditional exclusion) and refuses by default for any traversal absent an explicit, non-fleet-sealed unattended attestation (a system_events row, event_type='PROBE_S0_S5_UNATTENDED_ATTESTATION', payload.sealed_by in solomon/chairman). A repo-wide search found NO existing attended/unattended tracking mechanism to reuse (ventures.is_demo/is_scaffolding answer a different question); per this PRD's explicit design requirement, the predicate is FAIL-CLOSED BY ABSENCE -- a missing, unreadable, or errored attestation read is refused, never treated as proof of unattendedness. BINDING CITATION CORRECTION (Solomon pre-LEAD discharge e9087f46, independently corroborated by VALIDATION on-instrument: '5c4528b0' resolves to ZERO rows in chairman_decisions and session_coordination): the SD's SC3 wording is corrected here from '...refuses citing ruling 5c4528b0...' to 'W3 packet ruling, coordination corr 5c4528b0', co-citing chairman_decisions rows beca4a47 and d580dac7 (both verified-real, decision_type=session_question, status=approved), so the fence's authority never rests on a single hard-to-search surface. This exact reworded citation appears verbatim as a code comment at the top of lib/eva/kill-gate-teeth/firing-fence.js.
acceptance_criteria: evaluateFiringFence() refuses (armed=false) when no unattended attestation exists for the venture
evaluateFiringFence() refuses unconditionally for a venture named ApexNiche even when a valid attestation is present
evaluateFiringFence() arms (armed=true) only when a non-venture-1 venture carries a valid solomon/chairman-sealed attestation
A read failure on either the venture-identity lookup or the attestation lookup refuses (fail-closed), never arms
The reworded citation 'W3 packet ruling, coordination corr 5c4528b0' co-citing beca4a47 and d580dac7 appears verbatim in lib/eva/kill-gate-teeth/firing-fence.js

functional_requirements.title: Kill set derived live from venture_stages.gate_type, never hardcoded
functional_requirements.description: lib/eva/kill-gate-teeth/kill-stage-set.js's deriveLiveKillStages() is the single authorized read site for kill-set membership: `SELECT stage_number FROM venture_stages WHERE gate_type = 'kill'` (currently {3,5,13,24}). This is documented as the correct surface, NOT venture_stages.work_type, despite scripts/modules/architectural-prevention/stage-gate-type-canonicalize-invariant.js declaring gate_type a lossy mirror of work_type for its OWN (decision_type classification) purpose -- work_type='decision_gate' conflates the 4 kill stages with promotion stages 10/16/17/25 and cannot express the kill/promotion distinction this module needs. Every other module in this SD (firing-verification.js, firing-fence.js's future BETA extensions) MUST call this shared helper rather than re-deriving or hardcoding the set.
acceptance_criteria: deriveLiveKillStages() returns the sorted, deduped stage_number list where gate_type='kill', reading live at call time

A grep census across lib/eva/kill-gate-teeth/**, database/migrations/20260829_kill_gate_sealed_predictions.sql shows zero hardcoded kill-stage-number literals used for kill-SET derivation outside kill-stage-set.js itself
kill-stage-set.js carries a code comment documenting the gate_type-vs-work_type tension so a future cleanup does not silently widen the kill set to 8 stages

No script in this SD's deliverables writes to roadmap_wave_items

technical_requirements.title: No modification to the live kill-gate seam
technical_requirements.description: lib/eva/lifecycle/thesis-kill-gate.js and lib/eva/lifecycle/thesis-kill-evaluator.js are read-only inputs to this SD's observation tooling. This SD builds proof/observation infrastructure around that seam and never edits it -- the regime being proved must not also be the thing doing the proving.

technical_requirements.title: Additive-only migration
technical_requirements.description: database/migrations/20260829_kill_gate_sealed_predictions.sql only CREATEs new tables/role/function; it does not ALTER any existing table. Applying it is a chairman/coordinator-reviewed step separate from this PRD's authoring (the ALPHA-builder session that authored it does not self-apply schema DDL to the shared production database).

technical_requirements.title: No live probe execution
technical_requirements.description: No code in this SD's scope creates, injects, or advances a real designed-to-fail venture. The ALPHA/BETA probe run itself is chairman-gated and out of scope per spec section 6; this SD ships only the harness the eventual run will use.

test_scenarios.expected: A real Postgres session assuming kill_gate_traversal_ro gets SQLSTATE 42501 on a direct SELECT against kill_gate_sealed_predictions
The same session's call to kill_gate_teeth_discharged_predictions() succeeds and returns only rows with discharged_at IS NOT NULL
verifyFiringForCrossing() correctly classifies matched_prediction as true, false, or null per fixture combinations of sealed predictions and system_events rows
evaluateFiringFence() refuses (armed=false) absent an explicit unattended attestation, and refuses unconditionally for ApexNiche even with one present
deriveLiveKillStages() reads venture_stages.gate_type='kill' and returns the current live set, with no hardcoded stage list in the module

risks.risk: No production call site is actually forced through the kill_gate_traversal_ro role today; the blindness mechanism is proven but not yet wired into the live traversal path.
risks.mitigation: Documented explicitly in the migration's header comment and here as a residual gap; wiring a restricted connection into stage-advancement call sites is out of ALPHA-leg scope and tracked as future work, not silently absorbed.

risks.risk: The kill gate ships LEO_THESIS_KILL_GATE=observe by default -- a FIRED verdict is logged but never blocks advancement, so a teeth-proof record's observed_verdict='fired' does not by itself prove the venture was actually stopped.
risks.mitigation: Every teeth-proof record persists flag_mode at evaluation time; report consumers (Solomon) must read flag_mode alongside observed_verdict and never infer blocking from a fired verdict under observe mode.

risks.risk: No existing attended/unattended traversal tracking mechanism exists in this codebase; the firing fence's arming predicate depends on a NEW attestation event type that nothing yet writes.
risks.mitigation: Fail-closed-by-absence default: the fence never arms without that attestation, so the absence of a writer is safe (over-refusal), not a silent bypass. Writing the attestation is run-prep's job (chairman-gated, out of ALPHA-leg scope), documented explicitly in firing-fence.js.

risks.risk: Supabase force-hardens new views to security_invoker=on on this project, which silently defeats the classic 'view exposes owner privileges' blindness pattern used elsewhere in Postgres tooling.
risks.mitigation: Adopted a SECURITY DEFINER function instead (unaffected by that view-specific hardening), verified end-to-end against the live project before shipping; documented in the migration comment so a future author does not reintroduce a view-based version expecting the textbook default.

consumers: Solomon (queries kill_gate_teeth_proof_records / getTeethProofReport() for sealed-terms discharge duty)
A future PROBE-ALPHA/BETA run-prep harness (chairman-gated, not built in this SD) that will write sealed predictions, discharge them, and check evaluateFiringFence() before arming
dependencies: ventures table (venture identity lookup for the firing fence)
data_contracts: system_events.event_type='PROBE_S0_S5_UNATTENDED_ATTESTATION' (new contract, not yet written by any producer -- fail-closed until one exists)
runtime_config: None. This SD introduces no new feature flags; LEO_THESIS_KILL_GATE (pre-existing) is read, never set, by firing-verification.js
observability_rollout: kill_gate_teeth_proof_records is the durable, queryable rollout surface; no dashboard change in this SD's scope

system_architecture.summary: Three new pure/DB-backed modules under lib/eva/kill-gate-teeth/, one additive migration, zero changes to the live kill-gate seam.

implementation_approach.summary: Build the registry + blindness mechanism first (it gates everything else), then the verification harness against the pinned system_events surface, then the fence as an independent predicate module.
steps: Author the migration: sealed-prediction table, teeth-proof-records table, kill_gate_traversal_ro role, kill_gate_teeth_discharged_predictions() SECURITY DEFINER function
Smoke-test the blindness mechanism live (rolled-back transaction) to confirm the real 42501 denial and the RPC's filtered access before writing the automated test
Implement kill-stage-set.js, firing-verification.js, firing-fence.js with unit tests
Write the two-sided blindness integration test gated by this repo's designated-non-prod-target convention
Hand off the migration file for coordinator review/apply (not self-applied)
